title: Entity Controller Blocks
description: Control any entity's movement, rotation, and actions with just a few simple blocks.
body:
This mod would be perfect for Minecraft players who create videos. Especially for those who have friends that don't play Minecraft. 

Using mannequins from Minecraft's new update, you can basically create fake players that move around, look around, and even attack. All with the power of these blocks:

**-Entity Rotator: change the rotation of an entity.**

**-Entity Mover: change the motion of an entity. many options. move toward pos, move toward face.**

**-Entity Action Executer: make ANY entity attack, jump, or sneak. many options. attack cooldown, chance of missing.**

**-Entity Pose Setter: set the pose of an entity. (sneak, swim, stand, etc) ONLY WORKS ON MANNEQUINS**

**-Entity Controller: make an entity controller another entity. (acts like a repeating command block that tps entities to another)**

**MORE INFO IN GALLERY**

This mod also adds a new redstone block called the Redstone Timer. When activated, it will emit redstone for a certain amount of time (determine the time using the gui), then once the time runs out it will stop emitting and will pass the redstone to another block. This will be useful for making sequences of the entity controllers to have full control over an entity.
